literal_meaning: কূট (বাঁকা বা প্রতারণামূলক) + কৌশল (কৌশল বা কৌতূহল)
figurative_meaning_en: Cunning or sly trickery, especially the clever strategy of pitting one against another
similar_in_english: Play both ends against the middle
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে কূটকৌশল করে দুই প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে একে অপরের বিরুদ্ধে লাগিয়ে দিল।
রাজনীতিতে কূটকৌশলের ব্যবহার করে অনেকেই সাফল্য লাভ করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He used cunning tactics to pit his two rivals against each other.
In politics, many achieve success through sly strategies.
history: This idiom draws from ancient Indian strategic concepts, often associated with political maneuvering in historical texts like the Arthashastra.
note: The idiom emphasizes manipulative intelligence in conflicts, deeply embedded in South Asian cultural narratives.
